title: ICSSR Research Internship 2027
summary: Full-time research internship at the Indian Council of Social Science Research, New Delhi — 3 months for junior and 6 months for senior interns.
eligibility: Junior: currently pursuing a master's in social sciences. Senior: master's in social sciences with 55%+.
notes: The 2026 call closed in July–August 2026; watch icssr.org → Opportunities → Internships for the next notification.
Applications were by email or post, as set out in the notification.
